//comment: RISC-V instruction descriptions for hover provider
lui:
Load Upper Immediate. Places the 20-bit immediate in bits [31:12] of rd, filling bits [11:0] with zeros.

`rd ← imm << 12`
auipc:
Add Upper Immediate to PC.

`rd ← pc + (imm << 12)`
jal:
Jump And Link.

`rd ← pc + 4; pc ← pc + offset`
jalr:
Jump And Link Register.

`rd ← pc + 4; pc ← (rs1 + offset) & ~1`
beq:
Branch if Equal.

`if (rs1 == rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
bne:
Branch if Not Equal.

`if (rs1 != rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
blt:
Branch if Less Than (signed).

`if (rs1 < rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
bge:
Branch if Greater or Equal (signed).

`if (rs1 >= rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
bltu:
Branch if Less Than (unsigned).

`if (rs1 <u rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
bgeu:
Branch if Greater or Equal (unsigned).

`if (rs1 >=u rs2) pc ← pc + offset`
slli:
Shift Left Logical Immediate.

`rd ← rs1 << shamt`
srli:
Shift Right Logical Immediate.

`rd ← rs1 >>u shamt`
srai:
Shift Right Arithmetic Immediate.

`rd ← rs1 >>s shamt`
fence:
Memory Fence. Orders memory operations.

`fence pred, succ` where pred/succ ⊆ {i,o,r,w}
ecall: Environment Call. Requests service from execution environment (system call).
ebreak: Environment Break. Transfers control to debugger.
slliw:
Shift Left Logical Immediate Word.

`rd ← sext((rs1 << shamt)[31:0])`
srliw:
Shift Right Logical Immediate Word.

`rd ← sext(rs1[31:0] >>u shamt)`
sraiw:
Shift Right Arithmetic Immediate Word.

`rd ← sext(rs1[31:0] >>s shamt)`
sllw:
Shift Left Logical Word.

`rd ← sext((rs1 << rs2[4:0])[31:0])`
srlw:
Shift Right Logical Word.

`rd ← sext(rs1[31:0] >>u rs2[4:0])`
sraw:
Shift Right Arithmetic Word.

`rd ← sext(rs1[31:0] >>s rs2[4:0])`
fence.i: Instruction Fence. Synchronizes instruction and data streams.
csrrw:
CSR Read/Write. Atomically swap CSR and rs1.

`t ← csr; csr ← rs1; rd ← t`
csrrs:
CSR Read/Set. Read CSR, then set bits.

`rd ← csr; csr ← csr | rs1`
csrrc:
CSR Read/Clear. Read CSR, then clear bits.

`rd ← csr; csr ← csr & ~rs1`
csrrwi:
CSR Read/Write Immediate.

`t ← csr; csr ← zext(imm); rd ← t`
csrrsi:
CSR Read/Set Immediate.

`rd ← csr; csr ← csr | zext(imm)`
csrrci:
CSR Read/Clear Immediate.

`rd ← csr; csr ← csr & ~zext(imm)`
sc.w:
Store-Conditional Word.

`if (reserved(base)) { mem[base] ← src; rd ← 0 } else rd ← 1`
sc.d:
Store-Conditional Doubleword.

`if (reserved(base)) { mem[base] ← src; rd ← 0 } else rd ← 1`
amoswap.w:
Atomic Swap Word.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← src`
amoswap.d:
Atomic Swap Doubleword.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← src`
amoadd.w:
Atomic Add Word.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd + src`
amoadd.d:
Atomic Add Doubleword.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd + src`
amoxor.w:
Atomic XOR Word.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd ^ src`
amoxor.d:
Atomic XOR Doubleword.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd ^ src`
amoand.w:
Atomic AND Word.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd & src`
amoand.d:
Atomic AND Doubleword.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd & src`
amoor.w:
Atomic OR Word.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd | src`
amoor.d:
Atomic OR Doubleword.

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← rd | src`
amomin.w:
Atomic Min Word (signed).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← min(rd, src)`
amomin.d:
Atomic Min Doubleword (signed).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← min(rd, src)`
amomax.w:
Atomic Max Word (signed).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← max(rd, src)`
amomax.d:
Atomic Max Doubleword (signed).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← max(rd, src)`
amominu.w:
Atomic Min Word (unsigned).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← minu(rd, src)`
amominu.d:
Atomic Min Doubleword (unsigned).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← minu(rd, src)`
amomaxu.w:
Atomic Max Word (unsigned).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← maxu(rd, src)`
amomaxu.d:
Atomic Max Doubleword (unsigned).

`rd ← mem[addr]; mem[addr] ← maxu(rd, src)`
fmadd.s:
Float Fused Multiply-Add Single.

`fd ← (fs1 × fs2) + fs3`
fmsub.s:
Float Fused Multiply-Subtract Single.

`fd ← (fs1 × fs2) - fs3`
fnmadd.s:
Float Negative Fused Multiply-Add Single.

`fd ← -(fs1 × fs2) - fs3`
fnmsub.s:
Float Negative Fused Multiply-Subtract Single.

`fd ← -(fs1 × fs2) + fs3`
fcvt.w.s:
Float Convert to Word from Single.

`rd ← (int32)fs1`
fcvt.wu.s:
Float Convert to Unsigned Word from Single.

`rd ← (uint32)fs1`
fcvt.s.w:
Float Convert to Single from Word.

`fd ← (float)rs1`
fcvt.s.wu:
Float Convert to Single from Unsigned Word.

`fd ← (float)(uint32)rs1`
fcvt.l.s:
Float Convert to Long from Single (RV64).

`rd ← (int64)fs1`
fcvt.lu.s:
Float Convert to Unsigned Long from Single (RV64).

`rd ← (uint64)fs1`
fcvt.s.l:
Float Convert to Single from Long (RV64).

`fd ← (float)rs1`
fcvt.s.lu:
Float Convert to Single from Unsigned Long (RV64).

`fd ← (float)(uint64)rs1`
fsgnjn.s:
Float Sign Inject Negate Single.

`fd ← {~fs2[31], fs1[30:0]}`
fsgnjx.s:
Float Sign Inject XOR Single.

`fd ← {fs1[31] ^ fs2[31], fs1[30:0]}`
fle.s:
Float Less or Equal Single.

`rd ← (fs1 <= fs2) ? 1 : 0`
fclass.s: Float Classify Single. Returns 10-bit mask classifying fs1 (NaN, Inf, zero, subnormal, normal).
fmv.x.w:
Float Move to Integer from Single (bit copy).

`rd ← fs1`
fmv.w.x:
Float Move to Single from Integer (bit copy).

`fd ← rs1`
fmadd.d:
Float Fused Multiply-Add Double.

`fd ← (fs1 × fs2) + fs3`
fmsub.d:
Float Fused Multiply-Subtract Double.

`fd ← (fs1 × fs2) - fs3`
fnmadd.d:
Float Negative Fused Multiply-Add Double.

`fd ← -(fs1 × fs2) - fs3`
fnmsub.d:
Float Negative Fused Multiply-Subtract Double.

`fd ← -(fs1 × fs2) + fs3`
fcvt.w.d:
Float Convert to Word from Double.

`rd ← (int32)fs1`
fcvt.wu.d:
Float Convert to Unsigned Word from Double.

`rd ← (uint32)fs1`
fcvt.d.w:
Float Convert to Double from Word.

`fd ← (double)rs1`
fcvt.d.wu:
Float Convert to Double from Unsigned Word.

`fd ← (double)(uint32)rs1`
fcvt.l.d:
Float Convert to Long from Double (RV64).

`rd ← (int64)fs1`
fcvt.lu.d:
Float Convert to Unsigned Long from Double (RV64).

`rd ← (uint64)fs1`
fcvt.d.l:
Float Convert to Double from Long (RV64).

`fd ← (double)rs1`
fcvt.d.lu:
Float Convert to Double from Unsigned Long (RV64).

`fd ← (double)(uint64)rs1`
fsgnjn.d:
Float Sign Inject Negate Double.

`fd ← {~fs2[63], fs1[62:0]}`
fsgnjx.d:
Float Sign Inject XOR Double.

`fd ← {fs1[63] ^ fs2[63], fs1[62:0]}`
fle.d:
Float Less or Equal Double.

`rd ← (fs1 <= fs2) ? 1 : 0`
fclass.d: Float Classify Double. Returns 10-bit mask classifying fs1 (NaN, Inf, zero, subnormal, normal).
fmv.x.d:
Float Move to Integer from Double (RV64, bit copy).

`rd ← fs1`
fmv.d.x:
Float Move to Double from Integer (RV64, bit copy).

`fd ← rs1`
c.addi16sp:
Compressed Add Immediate to SP × 16.

`sp ← sp + imm`
c.addi4spn:
Compressed Add Immediate × 4 to SP.

`rd ← sp + imm`
c.jalr:
Compressed Jump And Link Register.

`ra ← pc + 2; pc ← rs1`
c.beqz:
Compressed Branch if Equal Zero.

`if (rs1 == 0) pc ← pc + offset`
c.bnez:
Compressed Branch if Not Equal Zero.

`if (rs1 != 0) pc ← pc + offset`
c.lwsp:
Compressed Load Word from Stack.

`rd ← mem[sp + offset]`
c.swsp:
Compressed Store Word to Stack.

`mem[sp + offset] ← src`
c.ldsp:
Compressed Load Doubleword from Stack (RV64).

`rd ← mem[sp + offset]`
c.sdsp:
Compressed Store Doubleword to Stack (RV64).

`mem[sp + offset] ← src`
c.slli:
Compressed Shift Left Logical Immediate.

`rd ← rd << shamt`
c.srli:
Compressed Shift Right Logical Immediate.

`rd ← rd >>u shamt`
c.srai:
Compressed Shift Right Arithmetic Immediate.

`rd ← rd >>s shamt`
c.jal:
Compressed Jump And Link (RV32 only).

`ra ← pc + 2; pc ← pc + offset`
sh1add.uw:
Shift Left 1 and Add (zext rs1, RV64).

`rd ← (zext(rs1[31:0]) << 1) + rs2`
sh2add.uw:
Shift Left 2 and Add (zext rs1, RV64).

`rd ← (zext(rs1[31:0]) << 2) + rs2`
sh3add.uw:
Shift Left 3 and Add (zext rs1, RV64).

`rd ← (zext(rs1[31:0]) << 3) + rs2`
slli.uw:
Shift Left Logical Immediate (zext rs1, RV64).

`rd ← zext(rs1[31:0]) << shamt`
roriw:
Rotate Right Immediate Word (RV64).

`rd ← sext(ror32(rs1[31:0], shamt))`
czero.eqz:
Conditional Zero if Equal Zero.

`rd ← (rs2 == 0) ? 0 : rs1`
czero.nez:
Conditional Zero if Not Equal Zero.

`rd ← (rs2 != 0) ? 0 : rs1`
cbo.clean: Cache Block Clean. Writes back cache line if dirty.
cbo.flush: Cache Block Flush. Writes back and invalidates cache line.
cbo.inval: Cache Block Invalidate. Invalidates cache line.
prefetch.i: Prefetch Instruction. Hint to prefetch instruction cache line.
prefetch.r: Prefetch Read. Hint to prefetch data cache line for reading.
prefetch.w: Prefetch Write. Hint to prefetch data cache line for writing.
cbo.zero: Cache Block Zero. Zeros entire cache line.
pause: Pause. Hint that reduces power consumption in spin-wait loops.
fence.tso: TSO Fence. Orders all load/store operations (Total Store Order).
vsetvli:
Vector Set VL Immediate. Sets vector length and type configuration.

`vl ← vsetvli(rs1, vtypei)`
vsetivli:
Vector Set VL Immediate with Immediate AVL.

`vl ← vsetivli(uimm, vtypei)`
wfi: Wait For Interrupt. Stalls hart until interrupt.
mret: Machine Return. Returns from machine-mode trap handler.
sret: Supervisor Return. Returns from supervisor-mode trap handler.
uret: User Return. Returns from user-mode trap handler.
sfence.vma: Supervisor Fence Virtual Memory. Flushes TLB entries.
li:
Load Immediate.

`rd ← imm`

**Encoding:** `lui` + `addi` (or `addi` alone for small values)
negw:
Negate Word (RV64).

`rd ← sext(-rs[31:0])`

**Encoding:** `subw rd, x0, rs`
sext.w:
Sign Extend Word (RV64).

`rd ← sext(rs[31:0])`

**Encoding:** `addiw rd, rs, 0`
seqz:
Set if Equal Zero.

`rd ← (rs == 0) ? 1 : 0`

**Encoding:** `sltiu rd, rs, 1`
snez:
Set if Not Equal Zero.

`rd ← (rs != 0) ? 1 : 0`

**Encoding:** `sltu rd, x0, rs`
sltz:
Set if Less Than Zero.

`rd ← (rs < 0) ? 1 : 0`

**Encoding:** `slt rd, rs, x0`
sgtz:
Set if Greater Than Zero.

`rd ← (rs > 0) ? 1 : 0`

**Encoding:** `slt rd, x0, rs`
beqz:
Branch if Equal Zero.

`if (rs == 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `beq rs, x0, offset`
bnez:
Branch if Not Equal Zero.

`if (rs != 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bne rs, x0, offset`
blez:
Branch if Less or Equal Zero.

`if (rs <= 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bge x0, rs, offset`
bgez:
Branch if Greater or Equal Zero.

`if (rs >= 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bge rs, x0, offset`
bltz:
Branch if Less Than Zero.

`if (rs < 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `blt rs, x0, offset`
bgtz:
Branch if Greater Than Zero.

`if (rs > 0) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `blt x0, rs, offset`
bgt:
Branch if Greater Than.

`if (rs1 > rs2) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `blt rs2, rs1, offset`
ble:
Branch if Less or Equal.

`if (rs1 <= rs2) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bge rs2, rs1, offset`
bgtu:
Branch if Greater Than (unsigned).

`if (rs1 >u rs2) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bltu rs2, rs1, offset`
bleu:
Branch if Less or Equal (unsigned).

`if (rs1 <=u rs2) pc ← pc + offset`

**Encoding:** `bgeu rs2, rs1, offset`
call:
Call (far).

`ra ← pc + 8; pc ← symbol`

**Encoding:** `auipc ra, offsetHi` + `jalr ra, offsetLo(ra)`
tail:
Tail Call (far).

`pc ← symbol`

**Encoding:** `auipc t1, offsetHi` + `jalr x0, offsetLo(t1)`
fmv.s:
Float Move Single.

`fd ← fs`

**Encoding:** `fsgnj.s fd, fs, fs`
fabs.s:
Float Absolute Single.

`fd ← |fs|`

**Encoding:** `fsgnjx.s fd, fs, fs`
fneg.s:
Float Negate Single.

`fd ← -fs`

**Encoding:** `fsgnjn.s fd, fs, fs`
fmv.d:
Float Move Double.

`fd ← fs`

**Encoding:** `fsgnj.d fd, fs, fs`
fabs.d:
Float Absolute Double.

`fd ← |fs|`

**Encoding:** `fsgnjx.d fd, fs, fs`
fneg.d:
Float Negate Double.

`fd ← -fs`

**Encoding:** `fsgnjn.d fd, fs, fs`
csrr:
CSR Read.

`rd ← csr`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, csr, x0`
csrw:
CSR Write.

`csr ← rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrw x0, csr, rs`
csrs:
CSR Set bits.

`csr ← csr | rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrs x0, csr, rs`
csrc:
CSR Clear bits.

`csr ← csr & ~rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrc x0, csr, rs`
csrwi:
CSR Write Immediate.

`csr ← zext(imm)`

**Encoding:** `csrrwi x0, csr, imm`
csrsi:
CSR Set Immediate.

`csr ← csr | zext(imm)`

**Encoding:** `csrrsi x0, csr, imm`
csrci:
CSR Clear Immediate.

`csr ← csr & ~zext(imm)`

**Encoding:** `csrrci x0, csr, imm`
frcsr:
Float Read CSR.

`rd ← fcsr`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, fcsr, x0`
fscsr:
Float Swap CSR.

`rd ← fcsr; fcsr ← rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrw rd, fcsr, rs`
frrm:
Float Read Rounding Mode.

`rd ← frm`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, frm, x0`
fsrm:
Float Swap Rounding Mode.

`rd ← frm; frm ← rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrw rd, frm, rs`
frflags:
Float Read Flags.

`rd ← fflags`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, fflags, x0`
fsflags:
Float Swap Flags.

`rd ← fflags; fflags ← rs`

**Encoding:** `csrrw rd, fflags, rs`
rdtime:
Read Time.

`rd ← time`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, time, x0`
rdcycle:
Read Cycle.

`rd ← cycle`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, cycle, x0`
rdinstret:
Read Instructions Retired.

`rd ← instret`

**Encoding:** `csrrs rd, instret, x0`
